# SaaS connector commands

| File | Command | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `commands/account-create.md` | Account Create | Create account on the source. |
| `commands/account-delete.md` | Account Delete | Remove account from a source. |
| `commands/account-disable.md` | Account Disable | Disable an account on the source. |
| `commands/account-discover.md` | Account Discover | Dynamically determine account schema from the source. |
| `commands/account-enable.md` | Account Enable | Enable an account on the source. |
| `commands/account-list.md` | Account List | Aggregate all accounts from the source into SailPoint Identity Security. |
| `commands/account-read.md` | Account Read | Aggregate a single account from the source into SailPoint Identity Security. |
| `commands/account-unlock.md` | Account Unlock | Lock and unlock an account on the source. |
| `commands/account-update.md` | Account Update | Update an account on the source. |
| `commands/application-discovery-list.md` | Application Discovery List | Return the applications that the source knows about. |
| `commands/authenticate.md` | Authenticate | Check a user's credentials on the source for pass-through authentication. |
| `commands/change-password.md` | Change Password | Change password for an account on the source. |
| `commands/config-options-read.md` | Config Options Read | Return a list of options for a source config field. |
| `commands/entitlement-list.md` | Entitlement List | Gather a list of all entitlements available on the source. |
| `commands/entitlement-read.md` | Entitlement Read | Fetch a single entitlement’s attributes from the source. |
| `commands/machine-identity-list.md` | Machine Identity List | Aggregate machine identities from one or more datasets on the source. |
| `commands/resource-list.md` | Resource List | Aggregate the resources in one dataset from the source. |
| `commands/source-data-discover.md` | Source Data Discover | Discover potential source data types. |
| `commands/source-data-read.md` | Source Data Read | Read source data. |
| `commands/ssf-stream.md` | SSF Stream Commands | Manage Shared Signals Framework (SSF) streams on a third-party transmitter. |
| `commands/test-connection.md` | Test Connection | Ensure the connector can communicate with the source. |
